scope: Real local app/SDK/IDB with anonymous HTTP interception; no live SQL/SNS or Apple-device verification

checks.name: all five real sections open with empty local compositions
create activity, select fixed sources, copy and edit page, preview and reload preserve data
editing or deleting an activity does not mutate an existing page copy
missing fixed version stays missing and existing older version never substitutes latest
page placement and visibility remain separate and toggles remove preview DOM
integrated download restores a remapped unbound copy with exact raw text and excerpt
invalid backup replaces valid candidate without installing anything
discover uses actual stored versions and reflection counts selected scope only
real IDB write abort preserves visible edits and retry saves once
keyboard Space and preview return keep a visible focus target
boundary: failed workbench save blocks global navigation and preserves same draft
boundary: malformed UTF-8 composition note is rejected without replacement characters or install
boundary: pending restore blocks scope navigation and opens only its new copy after completion
boundary: delayed composition read cannot overwrite a different section
